name: milo
description: Milo: an animated AI companion that lives on your screen

scripts.dev: npm run build:hands && npm run build:main && concurrently -k -n vite,main,electron "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist/main/main.js && cross-env MILO_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:hands && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test:milo: npm run build:hands && npm run build:main && concurrently -k -s command-electron -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env MILO_DEV=1 MILO_TEST=1 electron ."
scripts.dist: cross-env MILO_UNIVERSAL=1 npm run build && electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.dist:unsigned: cross-env MILO_UNIVERSAL=1 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && electron-builder --mac --universal -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.test:jobs: npm run build:hands && npm run build:main && concurrently -k -s command-electron -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env MILO_DEV=1 MILO_TEST_JOBS=1 electron ."
